Name: Tego's Street and River Farms for MTN
Author: Gundulka
Description:
This is a MTN farm layout I created for myself. The farm is adjacent to a road and fenced, with plenty of space for farming, two ponds and a lake. Up to 8 cabins can be built (there's even a special spot dedicated for them).

[s]I don't intend to change the layout in any way or fix any bugs. Just posting it here because maybe someone will like it. 
[/s][b][color=#f1c232][size=4]I've fixed some bugs and added a river version (works like a Riverland farm). Enjoy!

[/size][/color]Big thanks to SgtPickles (aka GameMX) for creating MTN. [/b]

[color=#6aa84f][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [b]SMAPI[/b];
[*]Download and install [b]MTN (More Than Necessary)[/b];
[*]Unpack and put the folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods;
[*]Pick your farm while starting new game;
[*]Optional: Rename TegoFarmXXX2 into TegoFarmXXX to get a roadless version.
[/list]
[b][color=#cc4125]KNOWN BUGS[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]The dog / cat likes to hang out in a non-accesible area behind the fence.
[*]Greenhouse is rendered into a wrong layer.
[*]Grandpa's note is not rendered in the right spot.
[/list]
